comparison.objective: Unhook and remove an air-fryer basket, then place and release it; candidate extracts a small electrical terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Clear hooks while supporting and transporting a large basket versus wire bending and precision blade-mediated latch release.
comparison.success_condition: Basket unhooked, stable on mat and released without collisions/drop; candidate requires only the selected terminal removed with connector integrity preserved. Candidate force/damage thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Removal is generic; the mechanisms, scale and success state are unrelated.
